svg.title: For the completed plate and symmetric reference covariance set Serr = ACref −I and bhβ = −g−1(A drift +b). The first correction at a link is its finite color pairing with z, multiplied by aperture: the cone profile at twice enforcement radius on hot links and one otherwise. An itinerary of n + 2 link steps has half-bilinear quadratic correction with the ordered block product of n + 1
